result.rationale: The controller code in the diff confirms the mechanism: `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` followed directly by `host.destroy` in destroy and `save_host(host)` (which calls `host.host = ...`) in update, with no nil check anywhere. A missing id would raise NoMethodError on nil, producing a 500 instead of a 404, exactly as described. Verifiable directly from the diff.

judged_text: update and destroy call save_host(host)/host.destroy on a record fetched with where(id: params[:id]).first without a nil check, so a missing or already-deleted id raises NoMethodError on nil. PUT/DELETE /admin/embeddable_hosts/:nonexistent_id returns a 500 instead of a 404; a double-delete from the UI (e.g. stale row after another admin removed it) hits this.
